共同操作

A1

步骤 1：treat vinylallene with catalyst before diazo addition；步骤 2：add diazo species 2a and continue the one-pot reaction；步骤 3：purification from a silica column

A2

步骤 1：add diazo species 2a and continue the one-pot reaction；步骤 2：purification from a silica column

A3

步骤 1：gold-catalyzed formation of substituted cyclopentadiene；步骤 2：add diazo ketone and continue one pot；步骤 3：purification from a silica column

A4

步骤 1：gold-catalyzed vinylallene cyclization in the presence of 4 Å molecular sieves；步骤 2：cool and hold with the listed CPA or phosphate before diazo addition；步骤 3：add diazo ketone and hold at 0 °C；步骤 4：warm to room temperature and hold; warming duration not reported；步骤 5：purification from a silica column
